claims.statement: The Payload config registers twenty collections in menu order: QuestGuides, AchievementPages, AchievementGroups, DofusGuides, Checklists, Pages, ClassPages, DungeonPages, Media, Quests, Items, Monsters, Dungeons, Npcs, SubAreas, AchievementCategories, Achievements, GameDataRefreshes, Redirects and Users, plus the DofusGuidesIndex, ChecklistsIndex, SiteSettings, IndexTexts and Navigation globals.

The users collection holds admin panel accounts with auth enabled, email as the admin title, a name and an admin or editor role, and locks an account for ten minutes after five failed logins; site members are meant to use Better Auth instead.
An anonymous local API request with overrideAccess false cannot list, read, create, update or delete panel users.

The media collection has a required localized alt, a localized credits field, a unique indexed read-only gameAsset key for imported game art, and an originalUrl validated by validateOptionalUrl, with uploads stored under the media static directory and image sizes generated on upload.
validateOptionalUrl accepts empty values and http or https URLs and returns an error message for anything else.
Media is publicly readable, create and update require a signed-in panel user, and delete requires an admin and passes the game art and reference delete guards.
When a public media base URL is configured, the storage plugin disables Payload access control for media files and generates CDN file URLs.
The initial migration stores localized media fields in a media_locales table and defines a _locales enum containing only es.
Spanish is the only configured locale and translatable fields are marked localized so a second language becomes a translation rather than a rewrite.
CI regenerates Payload types and fails when src/payload-types.ts differs from the committed file.
The quests collection holds DofusDB quest data in the panel group 'Datos del juego', with name as the admin title and name, dofusId and levelMin as default columns, wrapped in withTorreCorrection.

Quests have a required, unique and indexed numeric dofusId, a required localized name, optional levelMin, levelMax and categoryId numbers, an optional raw startCriterion text and an optional refreshedAt date.
Quest prerequisites are a hasMany relationship to other quests, and startPositions is an array of npcId, localized npcName, mapId, x, y and the start map's subAreaId.

Quests are readable by anyone, nobody creates or deletes them through the API, and a panel account's update is limited to the Corrección de Torre group, so only server code using the local API without a user writes the DofusDB fields.

The quests integration test shows an anonymous request can find and findByID quests, a panel user gets Forbidden on create and delete and only saves Torre's correction on update, and a create with overrideAccess true stores prerequisites, start positions and refreshedAt.
The quests migration stores localized quest fields in quests_locales and quests_start_positions_locales.
Apart from Torre's correction, the DofusDB refresh run by pnpm data:refresh is the only writer of the quests collection; it upserts quests by dofusId through the local API with overrideAccess true.
The refresh writes quest fields in a first pass and links prerequisites by Payload ID in a second pass, sets refreshedAt only on quests it creates or changes, and never deletes a quest.
The quest-guides collection sits in the panel group 'Contenido', uses title as the admin title and shows title, _status and updatedAt as default columns.
Quest guides have drafts enabled and keep at most 50 versions per document.

A quest guide has an optional single relationship to quests labelled Misión de DofusDB as its first field in the main area, a required localized title validated by validateGuideTitle, and a required unique indexed non-localized slug validated by validateGuideSlug.

The quest guide summary group holds a localized prerequisites textarea, a rewards section, a localized startNpc, numeric startX and startY, a localized zone and a level, and a needs group with an items array of required item relationships and quantities of at least 1, localized notes and hand-picked dungeons for dungeon notes.
The quest guide seo group has a localized metaTitle and a localized metaDescription limited to 160 characters, and originalUrl stores the Squarespace URL validated by validateOptionalUrl.

validateSlug accepts only lowercase ASCII letters and digits joined by single hyphens with no hyphen at either end, rejects empty values, accents, ñ, capitals and spaces, and also rejects reserved top-level route slugs.

Quest guide read access returns true for a signed-in panel user and a published-only _status query for anyone else; create and update require a signed-in panel user, and delete lets admins delete anything and editors only guides without a Squarespace URL.

The quest guides integration test shows an anonymous request reads the published guide but gets NotFound for a draft and Forbidden on create, update and delete, while a panel user reads drafts, publishes a draft and gets a published version.
The quest guides migration stores localized guide fields in quest_guides_locales and defaults _status to draft.

The Squarespace import writes title, slug, originalUrl, summary, quest and body through the local API with overrideAccess true, finding guides by original URL and then by slug including drafts and always saving drafts, so a published guide stays published until its new draft is published.
Media records created by the import hold the original file with alt and originalUrl and no variants, and are looked up by originalUrl so each image is stored once.

The import builds every summary field, with null for any the conversion did not bring, fills the empty ones from the linked DofusDB quest, and records what it wrote in importSnapshot so a rerun leaves alone fields Torre changed.

The quest rewards group holds experience, experienceMin and kamas numbers, an items array of required item relationships with required quantities, emoteIds, spellIds, titleIds and jobIds as hasMany number lists of DofusDB IDs, and byLevel tiers for rewards that change with the character's level.

The quest needs group holds an items array related to items, a monsters array related to monsters, each with a required quantity, and a walksMaps checkbox for objectives that ask to discover a map or sub-area.

Items, monsters, dungeons, NPCs and achievements share the quests' withTorreCorrection wrapper, so anyone can read them, nobody creates or deletes them through the API or the panel, and a panel account edits only the correction.

The items collection stores a required unique indexed dofusId, a required localized name, and optional level, typeId, superTypeId, iconId, image and refreshedAt fields under the 'Datos del juego' panel group.

The monsters collection holds the whole DofusDB monster catalog with a required unique indexed dofusId, a required localized name, an optional iconId taken from DofusDB's gfxId, an optional imported image and an optional refreshedAt.
Items and monsters keep the DofusDB icon ID and an image upload that the refresh imports once into Media; nothing is loaded from DofusDB or Ankama at runtime.
The DofusDB items migration stores localized item and monster names in items_locales and monsters_locales.
The refresh writes items and monsters before quests because quest rewards and needs reference their Payload IDs, and skips and counts item or monster references it cannot resolve.
The items collection holds the whole DofusDB item catalog rather than only quest-referenced items, because fetchQuestData downloads every item with fetchAll instead of looking items up by ID.
Items store an optional superTypeId mapped from the type.superTypeId DofusDB attaches to each item, where supertype 14 marks quest items.

The quest guide collection's beforeValidate hook fillFromQuest loads the linked quest at depth 1, fills an empty title and slug whenever they are empty, and fills the empty SEO and summary fields only when the guide is created or its quest changes, reading fields missing from a partial update from the saved document.

A filled guide slug gets a -2, -3 suffix when it is a reserved route slug, a redirect table source, or is already used anywhere in the root slug space (another quest guide excluding the one being saved, an achievement page, a metalogro, a Dofus guide, a checklist or a standalone page, drafts included).
validateGuideTitle and validateGuideSlug accept an empty value when the guide has a quest, and without a quest an empty title gets a Spanish error while the slug falls back to validateSlug.

Because drafts are saved without field validation, fillFromQuest throws a ValidationError on the title path when the title is still empty after the fill, so a guide with neither title nor quest is rejected even as a draft.

Each fillable summary field, the reward numbers, reward items and reward levels, and the needs items array use the SummaryNote client component as their admin description, passing the field name as summaryField.
The needs item list is filled from DofusDB only when it is empty, and the needs notes are never filled automatically.

The Squarespace import links a quest only when the guide names exactly one DofusDB ID; with several IDs it links none and records the oddity 'Varias misiones de DofusDB (…): sin enlazar, elige una en el panel'.

The npcs collection stores DofusDB NPCs that give quests or that quest objectives name, with a unique indexed dofusId, a localized name, the DofusDB look string and right- and left-facing renders uploaded to media, with Torre's correction as the only panel-editable part.
Quests store a localized zone and an achievement group with the achievement's DofusDB ID, localized name, slug, the quest's position and the achievement's quest total.

Quest guides and media expire the cached guide pages, achievement pages, Dofus guides, checklists and standalone pages in afterChange and afterDelete hooks, and the revalidation ignores the missing static generation store outside a Next request.

Quest guides configure Payload live preview and preview URLs through guidePreviewUrl, with 390 by 844 mobile, 1024 by 768 tablet and 1440 by 900 desktop breakpoints shared with the other editorial collections that have a page.
Quest guides run rejectSharedSlug after fillFromQuest so a guide cannot take a slug an achievement page, metalogro, Dofus guide or checklist already uses, or a redirect table source.

The dofus-guides collection has drafts with up to 50 versions, published-only reads for visitors and writes for panel users, rejects a slug another root collection uses, and expires the dofus-guides, guide-pages and checklists cache tags after a change or delete.
The dofus-guides-index global holds one localized rich-text intro, is readable by anyone and editable by panel users, and expires the dofus-guides cache tag when saved.

Quests store read-only stages from DofusDB, each with its objectives (kind, raw localized text, referenced NPC, monster or item, quantity, map, coordinates and subAreaId) in the order checklist progress counts them; show is a kind of its own, apart from bring.
A hand-picked dungeon row needs a note that is a dungeon note of the guide's needs notes and a required dungeon relationship, and rows whose dungeon was deleted are dropped on save.

The dungeons collection stores DofusDB dungeons with their bosses as monster relationships under the Torre correction wrapper, and the subareas collection stores DofusDB subareas with their area name, read-only in the panel except for Torre's zone background.

The checklists collection uses the editorial read rules with drafts, deletes through adminOrNotImported('importSnapshot'), disables duplication and mounts the checklist details and poster progress endpoints.
Below quest, title and slug, the quest guide form places body, summary and seo in three unnamed tabs (Contenido, Resumen, SEO) that only arrange the form.
Monsters also store their grade levels, boss and archmonster flags from DofusDB and the id of their first subarea, and dungeons store DofusDB's optimal player level.
The checklists-index global holds the «???» teaser poster of /checklists, readable by anyone and editable by panel users, and expires the checklists cache tag when saved.

A quest guide's summary holds structured rewards (XP, minimum XP, kamas, items, level tiers and other rewards) beside the Squarespace rewards text, and Torre's zone and level override DofusDB's in the guide subtitle.

The pages collection stores standalone pages with drafts, editorial access, a state with a Squarespace link, an optional parent page, the quest guide body blocks, SEO and an import snapshot, and shares the root slug space.
The game-data-refreshes collection logs each DofusDB refresh with its times, status, trigger, requester, report, error and summary, readable by panel accounts and writable by nobody through the API.
The redirects collection holds unique from addresses with a to target and a read-only auto flag, readable by anyone and editable by panel accounts, validating rows and collapsing chains in its hooks.

The class-pages and dungeon-pages collections are both built by sectionPageCollection with drafts, editorial access, delete through adminOrNotImported('importSnapshot'), rejectSharedSlug, the slug move hooks and afterChange and afterDelete hooks that expire the section-pages cache tag; class pages add PVM and PVP build rows and dungeon pages an optional DofusDB dungeon relationship.

A subarea holds Torre's zone background in background and backgroundMapId; only an admin updates a subarea, scopeSubAreaWrite keeps a panel update to those two fields, and saving one expires the guide-pages and achievement-pages tags.
Quest guides have an optional sidebar upload field background, shared with achievement pages through pageBackgroundField, that replaces the zone background of the guide's subarea.

Quest guides, achievement pages, Dofus guides, checklists and standalone pages carry a hidden contentUpdatedAt date that the trackContentDate beforeChange hook sets when a panel user publishes a content change; saves without a user never move it and a duplicate starts without it.
